description: This file contains utility functions and global variable declarations for the Notesnook editor mobile project, including message posting, theme management, and global state handling.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root element for message listening, depending on whether the environment is React Native WebView and Safari.

methods.name: getOnMessageListener
methods.description: Adds an event listener for 'onMessage' events and provides a method to remove it.

methods.name: randId
methods.description: Generates a random ID string with an optional prefix.

methods.name: isReactNative
methods.description: Checks if the environment is React Native WebView.

methods.name: logger
methods.description: Logs messages of type 'info', 'warn', or 'error' by posting to the React Native WebView.

methods.name: dbLogger
methods.description: Logs database-related messages, including errors, by posting to the WebView.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Sends a message to the React Native WebView with specified type and data, returning a generated resolver ID.

methods.name: postAsyncWithTimeout
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous post message with optional timeout, resolving or rejecting based on response or timeout.

methods.name: saveTheme
methods.description: Saves the current theme to local storage.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the saved theme from local storage.
